Stores inside their first 12 months (i.e. adding increment to comp): Q3FY26 = part-quarter Q3FY25 cohort (Aug cohort ~0.5 month, Sep ~1.5, Oct ~2.5 of the quarter) + Q4FY25-Q3FY26 openings; Q4FY26 = Q4FY25 FH (Nov-Jan, exiting) + all Q1-Q4 FY26 openings (HoS: Amherst, 5 Q2, 5 Q3, 3 Q4; FH 2+8+7+3).
